user.title: Connect to Kairos
user.description: Connect to the Kairos API and set the optimization schedule. Configure assets after setup.

data.switching_penalty: Storage Switching Penalty [cost per mode change]

data_description.api_url: Base URL of the Kairos API including the port, for example http://192.168.1.50:8000.
data_description.time_step_minutes: Length of each schedule slot, from 1 to 1440 minutes. Default 15.
data_description.optimization_steps: Run the optimization at every Nth time step, from 1 to 1440. 1 runs it at every time step. Default 1.
data_description.horizon_hours: How far ahead the schedule is planned, from 1 to 168 hours. Default 24.
data_description.request_timeout: Max wait for one API response, from 1 to 3600 seconds. Must be longer than the solver time limit and shorter than the time step. Default 60.
data_description.failure_threshold: Failed optimization runs before a repair issue is shown in Home Assistant, from 1 to 20. Default 3.
data_description.time_limit_s: Max solver run time per optimization, from 1 to 3600 seconds. Default 10.
data_description.relative_mip_gap: Stop once the best schedule is within this relative gap of the best bound, from 0 to 1. Set to 0 to require the solver to prove optimality. Default 0.
data_description.switching_penalty: Softly discourages storage mode changes between time steps. Set to 0 to allow switching freely. Default 0.1.
data_description.grid_peak_penalty: Dimensionless weight. At 0.40 currency/kWh with 15-minute steps, 0.1 means the optimizer can accept up to 1 cent higher energy cost for a 1 kW lower grid peak. Set to 0 to disable. Default 0.1.

asset_grid.title: Configure {asset_type}
asset_grid.description: Choose Home Assistant entities and enter parameters. An edited asset keeps its identifier so entities and history remain linked.

asset_pv.title: Configure {asset_type}
asset_pv.description: Choose Home Assistant entities and enter parameters. An edited asset keeps its identifier so entities and history remain linked. Use the created Enabled switch to include or exclude it.

asset_base_load.title: Configure {asset_type}
asset_base_load.description: Choose Home Assistant entities and enter parameters. An edited asset keeps its identifier so entities and history remain linked.

data_description.power_entity: The household's electrical power draw excluding every device modelled in Kairos (e.g. Home Battery and EV Battery charging, DHW Tank and Building Thermal Mass heat pumps, Controllable Loads).

asset_controllable_load.title: Configure {asset_type}
asset_controllable_load.description: Enter parameters. Kairos creates the Enabled, Run Start Time, Earliest Start Time and Latest Finish Time entities. Your automation should set Run Start Time to the time the device was last turned on.

asset_home_battery.title: Configure {asset_type}
asset_home_battery.description: Choose Home Assistant entities and enter parameters. Kairos creates the Enabled switch.

asset_ev_battery.title: Configure {asset_type}
asset_ev_battery.description: Choose Home Assistant entities and enter parameters. Kairos creates the Enabled, Round-Trip Distance, Expected Departure Time and Expected Arrival Time entities.

asset_dhw_tank.title: Configure {asset_type}
asset_dhw_tank.description: Choose Home Assistant entities and enter parameters. Kairos creates the Enabled switch.

data_description.min_water_temperature: Set to the ambient temperature around the tank. Sets the bottom of the state of charge scale and, together with the Max Water Temperature, the range used for passive discharge power.

asset_building_thermal_mass.title: Configure {asset_type}
asset_building_thermal_mass.description: Choose Home Assistant entities and enter parameters. Kairos creates the Enabled switch. The reference COP and COP outdoor temperature coefficient are derived from the history of the selected entities.

data_description.indoor_temperature_entity: Indoor temperature value and history. Used to calculate Heat Loss Coefficient and the current indoor temperature is used to derive COP as function of outdoor temperature.
data_description.outdoor_temperature_entity: Outdoor temperature history. Used to calculate Heat Loss Coefficient and to derive COP as function of outdoor temperature.
data_description.outdoor_temperature_forecast_attribute: Attribute of outdoor temperature sensor that contains the forecast. Used to calculate passive discharge power forecast by multiplying temperature difference with heat loss coefficient.
data_description.electric_power_entity: Heat pump electric power history. Used with Thermal Power and outdoor temperature to derive COP as function of outdoor temperature.
data_description.thermal_power_entity: Heat pump thermal output history. Used to calculate Heat Loss Coefficient and to derive COP as function of outdoor temperature.
data_description.min_room_temperature: Physical room temperature that corresponds to 0% state of charge.
data_description.max_room_temperature: Physical room temperature that corresponds to 100% state of charge.
data_description.min_comfort_temperature: Soft lower comfort bound. Dropping below it incurs a penalty. It should be set low enough below the normal indoor temperature to allow for some variation in temperature during normal heat pump operation.
data_description.max_comfort_temperature: Soft upper comfort bound. Exceeding it incurs a penalty. It should be set high enough above the normal indoor temperature to allow for some variation in temperature during normal heat pump operation.
data_description.heat_loss_coefficient: This is already calculated from historic indoor temperature, outdoor temperature and thermal power. If this is non-zero it will override the calculated value. Used to derive the Passive Discharge Power.
data_description.thermal_mass_coefficient: Heat storage capacity of the building per m² of floor area. This does not need be an exact number, the default is generally fine.
data_description.heating_rate: Indoor temperature rise per hour in +dT (charge) mode. Empirically determined. Used with Floor Area and Thermal Mass Coefficient to calculate the charge power.
data_description.plus_dt_flow_offset: Flow temperature offset on the weather compensation curve in +dT mode.
data_description.cooldown_rate: Indoor temperature change per hour in -dT (discharge) mode, entered as a negative value. Empirically determined. Used with Floor Area and Thermal Mass Coefficient to calculate the discharge power.
data_description.minus_dt_flow_offset: Flow temperature offset on the weather compensation curve in -dT mode.
data_description.cop_flow_temperature_sensitivity: Fractional change in COP per °C of flow temperature offset, e.g. -0.02 = -2%/°C.
